crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone…
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: After ten days, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah.
translations.bsb: After ten days the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of Jehovah came unto Jeremiah.
